title: Remove an agent tool
description: Stops its sessions and deletes the tool's environment from your home folder. Your code and git repositories are not touched.

steps.title: Stop its sessions and delete its environment
steps.why: Only the folder llmwizard created is removed.
steps.run:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
for s in $(tmux ls -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep "^llmw-$P_tool-" || true); do tmux kill-session -t "$s"; done
rm -rf "$D/agents/$P_tool"
